verdict.rationale: First-party docs claim Jira lets teams break big projects and ideas into actionable tasks, including AI-assisted breakdown via Rovo, which covers the decomposition half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents issue linking, dependency or 'blocks' relationships, or any visualization of blocking order. missing for 10: explicit subtask documentation, dependency/issue-linking with blocking semantics, visualization of blocking order, independent or hands-on corroboration.
